question.text: The maximum number of investors per scheme of an AIF (other than an Angel Fund) under SEBI (AIF) Regulations is:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that no AIF scheme shall have more than 1,000 investors, and that accredited investors are excluded while computing the number of investors in a scheme. Angel Funds are a separate regime governed by their own provisions. The Trap: Option A is the Companies Act 2013 private placement cap of 200 investors, not the AIF scheme cap. Option B is a fabricated intermediate number. Option D ignores the regulation altogether. Note: Source pages 107, 504 and 514-516 support the 1,000-investor cap with accredited investors excluded from the computation, subject to applicable accredited-investor requirements, and the separate Angel Fund regime.
